spans.s:
The affix युस् is added to ऊर्णा in the sense of मतुप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: छन्दस्-युस्

Before an इट् beginning substituted-Aorist of the परस्मैपद there is optional वृद्धि of the vowel of ऊर्णु।

Terms: Aorist वृद्धि

Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, the final उ of ऊर्णु optionally gets वृद्धि ।

Terms: गुण
